gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Admission normally requires acceptance into the research group of a Carleton chemistry faculty member, so line up a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: the normal requirement for admission to the Ph.D. program is an M.Sc. in Chemistry with a B+ (9.00 CGPA) average in the last two years of full-time study and acceptance into a research group of a member of the Department of Chemistry at Carleton University

funding.value: You are automatically considered for funding (TA, research stipend, scholarships) when you apply; any offer comes with the admission letter, with no guaranteed amount stated.
funding.quote: When submitting an application for admission to Carleton, students are automatically considered for funding and if eligible, will be notified in the Offer of Admission and Funding.

entry_route.value: An MSc in Chemistry (B+) is the normal route; exceptional bachelor's graduates with an A- average may be admitted directly.
entry_route.quote: the normal requirement for admission to the Ph.D. program is an M.Sc. in Chemistry | exceptional applicants holding a bachelor's degree, with demonstrated potential for independent thought and advanced research, with a minimum A- (10.00 CGPA) average in the last two years of study, may be directly admitted to the Ph.D. program

notes: Joint with the University of Ottawa through OCCI. Students from outside Canada or the US write orientation exams in their first term.
